_about: Draft capture values moved out of PLAN.md in revision 0.14. Quotas carry the clip design effect x1.6, an assumed prior until measured from the pilot 30 clips (intra-clip correlation, re-sized as for recall); test 40 pins the golden 392 x 1.6 -> 628.

designEffect.method: intra-clip correlation from the pilot 30 clips

firstWeek.classes: the Drone list; tree seeded from tree, vehicle from custom01
firstWeek.conditions: thin wires at range (wire height recorded), sky glare, motion blur
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 wire clips at range in R2; the integrator starts the obstacle layer and synthetic frames
firstWeek.usedBy: each quota names its loop row and output kind (action, alert or advisory); test 40 refuses a quota with no consumer
firstWeek.usedByNote: unmappedWire 628 feeds an advisory and the Gate 2 wire stratum only: the rangefinder is the covering sensor, and the camera is refused for unmapped wire at every tier

firstWeek.conditions: turbidity, glare, spray; medium and current speed recorded per clip
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 hull or pier clips in glare; the remote operator runs the takeover drill in simulation; the integrator starts the water step

medium.note: surfaced-only first loop; R2 refuses a water clip whose medium is not water-surface (underwater clips wait for the underwater row)

firstWeek.usedBy: each quota names its loop row and output kind (action, alert or advisory); test 40 refuses a quota with no consumer

firstWeek.classes: spill, smoke or fire, blocked exit, door open after hours
firstWeek.conditions: indoor light, night corridor; consented pictures only
firstWeek.day1: the camera integrator commits the values and the consent check; capture waits for consent
firstWeek.usedBy: each quota names its loop row and output kind (action, alert or advisory); test 40 refuses a quota with no consumer

firstWeek.classes: the MASS-AI and eXeL AI robot lists
firstWeek.conditions: night (visible + IR, or thermal seeded from thermal01), dust or mud; child height only with consent
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 night step clips; the integrator starts the ground step and dock marker
firstWeek.usedBy: each quota names its loop row and output kind (action, alert or advisory); test 40 refuses a quota with no consumer

pixelExtent.formula: extent_px = known size (m) x focal (px at the model input size) / minimum detection range (m); focal 457 px at 640, 228.5 px at 320 (70 deg)
pixelExtent.floor: each row states minBoxPx (proposed: wire and bird 2 px wide, every other class 8 px box width); a capture passes only at minBoxPx x 1.1 or more

rows.note: refused at every tier: covering sensor required (rangefinder)
refused at every tier without a wing speed cap
a 320 px card cannot carry Drone person: 640 tier or a covering sensor
a 320 px card cannot carry swimmer: 640 tier or the hull sonar/proximity sensor

pixelExtent.test: test 40 recomputes every px value and result from the parameter files and refuses a row with no minBoxPx or no result per tier; R2 refuses a capture under its class floor for the loop tier named on the card
pixelExtent._changed: 0.15: minBoxPx and a result per tier on every row
